en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that had failed with an API error over 6 hours earlier, or longer ago than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS` when set
zh: 修复了 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` 重新运行一个在 6 小时前或更早因 API 错误而失败的轮次的问题，或在设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS` 时超过该时长的问题
